steps.name: Add cancellation signal and shutdown to WalletService
steps.description: Introduce a cancellation signal (tokio::sync::Notify or Arc<AtomicBool> — no tokio-util) as a field on WalletService. Add pub fn shutdown(&self) (idempotent). Calling it notifies the signal so the background loop exits promptly.
steps.criteria: shutdown() can be called multiple times without panicking; after shutdown() the cancellation signal is in a notified/set state

steps.name: Update spawn_background_sync to select on cancellation
steps.description: Rewrite the sync loop so each iteration uses tokio::select! with two branches: one that waits for the sync interval and syncs, and one that observes the cancellation signal and breaks.
steps.criteria: After shutdown() is called the background loop exits on its next iteration without completing another sync; calling shutdown() again on an already-shut-down service does not panic

steps.name: Add SyncStatusDto::disabled_default() constructor
steps.description: Add pub fn disabled_default() -> SyncStatusDto returning is_syncing=false, all optional numeric fields None, last_error set to the serialized Disabled variant.
steps.criteria: disabled_default() returns is_syncing=false; its last_error encodes the Disabled error variant; all optional balance and block-height fields are None

steps.name: Create wallet_session.rs with WalletSession newtype
steps.description: Create application/wallet_session.rs. Define WalletSession wrapping Arc<std::sync::RwLock<Option<Arc<WalletService>>>>. Implement empty(), current(), and clear() (calls shutdown() on the held service before taking the slot). Expose in application/mod.rs.
steps.criteria: empty() produces a session whose current() is None; after clear() current() is None; clear() calls shutdown() on the prior service; RwLock poison is recovered via into_inner and never panics

steps.name: Implement init_from_mnemonic on WalletSession
steps.description: pub async fn init_from_mnemonic(&self, mnemonic, passphrase, network) builds a WalletService via load_admin_wallet (no RPC), shuts down any prior service, stores the new Arc. Returns InvalidMnemonic on bad input; slot stays None on any error.
steps.criteria: Valid mnemonic sets current() to Some; external address 0 equals load_admin_wallet(mnemonic) address 0; invalid mnemonic returns InvalidMnemonic and current() stays None; succeeds when BITCOIN_RPC_URL is unreachable; re-init shuts down the prior service leaving one bg loop

steps.name: Implement current_or_fallback with env-var fallback
steps.description: pub fn current_or_fallback() returns the live session (branch 1); only when slot is None reads ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC (branch 2) and caches the wallet; returns Disabled when env is also absent (branch 3). Only this function reads the env var.
steps.criteria: Session A with env=B returns service A not B; empty slot with env set builds and caches; second call returns same Arc pointer; empty slot with no env returns Disabled

phases.name: Migrate wallet IPC commands and add wallet_session_init

steps.name: Add WalletSessionInitInput DTO and wallet_session_init command
steps.description: In commands/admin_wallet.rs define WalletSessionInitInput (Deserialize, camelCase) with mnemonic, passphrase, network. Implement #[tauri::command] async fn wallet_session_init gated by ensure_dev_mnemonic_signing_allowed(). Register in invoke.rs under attach_with_dev_signing only.
steps.criteria: Valid mnemonic + ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING=1 returns Ok; invalid mnemonic returns InvalidMnemonic and slot stays None; missing dev-gate env returns gate error; command absent from attach_production handler set; no RPC contact on init

steps.name: Migrate six wallet commands from Arc<WalletService> to WalletSession
steps.description: Change state param of get_admin_wallet_info, get_admin_wallet_balance, list_admin_wallet_addresses, get_admin_wallet_utxos, fund_commit_transaction, admin_wallet_sync_status to tauri::State<WalletSession>. Async commands use current_or_fallback(); non-async sync_status uses current() + disabled_default().
steps.criteria: Any async wallet IPC with empty slot and no env returns Disabled without panic; admin_wallet_sync_status with empty slot returns disabled_default() values; all commands behave identically to prior behavior when session wallet is present

steps.name: Extend auth_logout to clear the wallet session slot
steps.description: Add tauri::State<WalletSession> to auth_logout. After authentication::logout(), call wallet_session.clear(). Ensures logout cancels the bg task and drops the session wallet.
steps.criteria: After auth_logout current() is None; next wallet IPC with no env fallback returns Disabled; the cleared service's cancellation signal was triggered before the slot was taken

steps.name: Replace managed Arc<WalletService> with WalletSession::empty()
steps.description: Delete build_wallet_service and dummy fallback from main.rs. Replace .manage(Arc<WalletService>) with .manage(WalletSession::empty()). main.rs must no longer reference ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC.
steps.criteria: main.rs contains no reference to ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC; build_wallet_service is removed; app compiles and starts with WalletSession::empty() as managed wallet state

phases.name: Frontend wiring — walletSessionInit bridge and session-provider

steps.name: Add walletSessionInit bridge to api/admin-wallet.ts
steps.description: Export async function walletSessionInit({ mnemonic, network }) calling the Tauri wallet_session_init command via the typed bridge. Passphrase omitted at this phase. Return type reflects Result<void>.
steps.criteria: walletSessionInit is an exported function in api/admin-wallet.ts; it invokes wallet_session_init with mnemonic and network in camelCase; return type is Result wrapping void

steps.name: Wire walletSessionInit in connectSession for mnemonic adapter
steps.description: In session-provider.tsx connectSession: after authenticate() succeeds, if adapter.vendor === 'mnemonic' call walletSessionInit with the adapter mnemonic. Other vendors skip the call so the slot stays empty and the panel shows Disabled.
steps.criteria: Mnemonic login calls walletSessionInit with the login mnemonic; HW-wallet login skips walletSessionInit and panel stays Disabled; after auth_logout the wallet panel returns to Disabled state

steps.name: SessionState holds commit_reveal_keypair
steps.description: Change WalletSession slot from Option<Arc<WalletService>> to Option<SessionState> with wallet + UntweakedKeypair. Add build_session_from_mnemonic that derives keypair via derive_commit_reveal_keypair. init_from_mnemonic and env fallback path store full SessionState. clear() drops both.
steps.criteria: init_from_mnemonic stores keypair matching derive_commit_reveal_keypair(mnemonic); clear() removes keypair; env fallback builds same SessionState shape

steps.name: commit_reveal_keypair_or_fallback on WalletSession
steps.description: pub fn commit_reveal_keypair_or_fallback(&self) -> Result<UntweakedKeypair, BroadcastEnvError>: active session key first; else env mnemonic derive (CI); else MissingEnv/MnemonicSigningDisabled. Only reader of ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC alongside current_or_fallback.
steps.criteria: Session mnemonic A with env B returns keypair for A; no session + env set returns env keypair; no session + no env returns error

steps.name: Session-aware load_broadcast_env
steps.description: Refactor broadcast_env.rs: load RPC/asm/network/timeouts from env; resolve commit_reveal_keypair via wallet_session.commit_reveal_keypair_or_fallback(). Remove direct ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC read from load_broadcast_env. Update unit tests.
steps.criteria: load_broadcast_env(&WalletSession) succeeds with session only (no env mnemonic) when ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING=1; existing broadcast_env guard tests updated

steps.name: Wire WalletSession into prepare/broadcast commands
steps.description: proposals_prepare_broadcast takes State<WalletSession> and passes to load_broadcast_env. proposals_broadcast already has session; ensure both use session key resolution. No behavior change for headless CI with env only.
steps.criteria: prepare and broadcast use same keypair source; integration/regression: session A env B uses A for prepare
